summary: Lipocine Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting solely that it will host a virtual key opinion leader (KOL) event on June 12, 2026, to discuss unmet needs in postpartum depression and the clinical profile of its investigational drug LPCN 1154. No financial terms, corporate action, or special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report announcing a promotional/educational KOL webinar. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The announcement is commercial in nature and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
